doc.title: Jerry Coker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 18, 2023

title: Praise for his 1964 improvisation book
summary: Rowe says Coker's 1964 book on swing still holds up.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: I do. I have a few of your books. And I’m amazed and happy when I read through this book, how well it holds up. You know? Some of the things you say, like you were talking about swing and how it works and how it doesn’t work, and it’s very interesting to think that you wrote this back in 1964 and it still works.
